title: Lemon and Goat Cheese Ravioli with Pink Peppercorns and Tarragon
changes_from_base: A turmeric and lemon-zest egg dough replaces the plain pasta, the filling is soft goat cheese crushed with chilli and pepper, and the round ravioli are finished with crushed pink peppercorns, tarragon, lemon and grapeseed oil instead of butter and parmesan.
summary: Delicate lemon-scented parcels hiding a soft, herb-flecked goat cheese centre, finished with crushed pink peppercorns and fresh tarragon.

ingredients.item: "00" pasta flour, plus extra for rolling
lemon, finely grated zest only, plus a squeeze of juice if you like
grapeseed oil (or a mild olive oil)
fine sea salt or table salt, for the cooking water

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: Beat 45 ml olive oil into 3 medium eggs, then work the mixture into 325 g 00 flour with ¼ tsp turmeric and the zest of 3 lemons until crumbly, adding a little extra flour or oil as needed and kneading until smooth.

steps.title: Rest
steps.text: Cut the dough into 4 chunky oblongs, cling-wrap each one and chill for 30 min or longer (they keep for up to 2 days).

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Press one block flat on a floured surface, then feed it through the pasta machine from the widest notch down to the thinnest, keeping the rolled sheets beneath a damp tea towel.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: Using a fork, crush 310 g goat cheese with ⅓ tsp flaky salt, ¼ tsp chilli flakes and ¼ tsp black pepper.

steps.title: Shape
steps.text: Stamp out 7.5 cm rounds, paint one with beaten egg white, spoon a rounded teaspoon of the cheese mix into the middle, cap with a second round and squeeze out the air, pressing firmly with floured fingers to leave a rim just under 1 cm.

steps.title: Dry
steps.text: Rest them on a tray dusted with 2 tbsp semolina for 10-15 min, or cover and refrigerate for up to a day.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Drop them into plenty of rapidly boiling water seasoned with 1 tbsp salt and cook for 2-3 min to al dente, then drain and share out between 4 warm plates.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Top with 2 tsp crushed pink peppercorns, 1 tsp tarragon and the zest of 1 lemon, drizzle over 30 ml grapeseed oil and add a squeeze of lemon if liked.

tips: Squeeze all the air out around the filling before sealing, so the ravioli don't burst as they cook.
Hold the rolled sheets under a damp tea towel to keep them pliable as you fill.
safety: Omit the pink peppercorns for anyone allergic to cashews, since they belong to the same plant family as cashews and mango.
For anyone pregnant, pick a pasteurised soft goat cheese.
storage: Best eaten straight away, though filled ravioli can be covered and chilled for up to a day before cooking. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
